source.inspectionScope: Complete40-line2-file patch read; new Copy command uses existing receiver, selection/full-target behavior inspected historically. Added assertion proves visibility only, not copied text or keyboard operation. Fixed receiver later uses raw header data and selection; no clipboard/UI test.

commit 133f0c8104a45a7d565ac9ee674a8484da549f8d
Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Fri May 23 10:36:23 2025 +0100
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Fri May 23 10:36:23 2025 +0100

    Bug 1965716 - Add Copy menuitem to list-id context menu. r=john.bieling
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D248744

diff --git a/mail/base/content/msgHdrPopup.inc.xhtml b/mail/base/content/msgHdrPopup.inc.xhtml
index 7ef05a6df74..47aaf4c93d4 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/msgHdrPopup.inc.xhtml
+++ b/mail/base/content/msgHdrPopup.inc.xhtml
@@ -156,6 +156,11 @@
               class="menuitem-iconic"
               disabled="true"/>
     <menuseparator/>
+    <menuitem id="listIdCopy"
+              data-l10n-id="text-action-copy"
+              class="menuitem-iconic"
+              oncommand="gMessageHeader.copyString(event);event.stopPropagation();"/>
+    <menuseparator/>
     <menuitem id="listIdListHelp" data-l10n-id="list-id-context-list-help"
               data-header-name="list-help"
               class="menuitem-iconic"/>
diff --git a/mail/test/browser/message-header/browser_messageHeader.js b/mail/test/browser/message-header/browser_messageHeader.js
index 2166b8a2b46..e65abc7dc23 100644
--- a/mail/test/browser/message-header/browser_messageHeader.js
+++ b/mail/test/browser/message-header/browser_messageHeader.js
@@ -882,6 +882,9 @@ add_task(async function test_context_menu_list_id() {
     "shown"
   );
 
+  const listIdCopy = aboutMessage.document.getElementById("listIdCopy");
+  Assert.equal(listIdCopy.hidden, false, "copy should show");
+
   const listIdPlaceHolder =
     aboutMessage.document.getElementById("listIdPlaceHolder");
   Assert.equal(listIdPlaceHolder.hidden, false, "list-id should show");
title: Bug 1965716 - Add Copy menuitem to list-id context menu. r=john.bieling
